events.name: The Crowd Swells
events.description: The ballroom seems to grow smaller as the crowd thickens around the dance floor.  Whispers of conversation are easily caught.
events.result: The "Read the room" action automatically succeeds this round.

events.name: An Unfortunate Joke
events.description: A humorous quip gets misinterpreted, and suspicion briefly sets in.
events.result: All characters must succeed a charm test when "Probing secrets" or "Telling tales" this round, or gain a chatter token.

events.name: Song Changes
events.description: The song finishes, and nobles find new partners before the next one begins.
events.result: At the start of this round, in initiative order, leaders must partner with a different adjacent follower if able, otherwise, decrease your Draw size by 1 and they partner with the same follower if they have no other options, or remain unpartnered if no adjacent followers.

events.name: Orchestral Error
events.description: A mistake in the music causes confusion among the dancers.
events.result: All nobles must succeed a Grace test to move this round, or lose their movement.

events.name: Refreshments Arrive
events.description: Refreshments are served, and nobles are revitalized by the delicacies.
events.result: The "Organize threads" action automatically succeeds this round.

events.name: Scenario special event
events.description: An unexpected occurance... can you make of it an opportunity?
events.result: Effects depend on the scenario. Follow the instructions provided in the scenario's special rules section.
